chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Were it not that I would cause hardship for my community, I would have commanded them to use the siwak at the wudu (ablution) of every salat (prayer)."

key_terms.أُمَّتِي: my community, meaning the Muslim ummah
key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.بِالسِّوَاكِ: with the siwak, the tooth-cleaning stick
key_terms.وُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about using siwak before prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith shows the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله concern for easing difficulty upon his community while also emphasizing the virtue of using the siwak. It indicates that siwak is highly recommended in connection with wudu (ablution) and salat (prayer), even though it was not made obligatory.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If it were not burdensome for my community, I would have commanded them to use siwak (tooth cleaning) with each wudu (ablution) before every prayer."
